# Pitfalls

The validator emits these fixes directly. They are listed here so a config can be written correctly the first time.

| If you see this property flagged | Do this |
| -------------------------------- | ------- |
| `arrayKey` | arrayKey should be at FIELD level, not inside props. |
| `col` | Hidden fields do NOT support `col`. Remove it (no layout needed). |
| `content` | Use `label` for text content and `props: { elementType }` for HTML element. |
| `derivation` | Use shorthand `derivation: '...'` or `logic: [{ type: 'derivation', expression: '...' }]`. Derivations are defined on the target field itself. |
| `disabled` | Hidden fields do NOT support `disabled`. Remove it. |
| `element` | Use `props: { elementType }` not `element` for text field HTML element. |
| `errorKind` | `errorKind` is a property of `responseMapping`, not a top-level validator property. Use: `responseMapping: { validWhen: "...", errorKind: "myError" }`. |
| `expressions` | Use `logic: [{ type: 'derivation', expression }]` or shorthand `derivation: '...'` - no `expressions` property exists. |
| `hidden` | Hidden fields do NOT support `hidden`. Remove it (the field is already hidden). |
| `hideWhen` | Use `logic: [{ type: 'hidden', condition: {...} }]` - no `hideWhen` shorthand exists. |
| `httpCondition` | HTTP conditions use `type: "http"` with `http: { url, method?, queryParams? }` and optional `responseExpression` to extract boolean from response. Set `pendingValue` for in-flight behavior. |
| `label` | Remove `label` from this container field (page/group/row/array). Use a `text` field inside for headings. |
| `logic` | Containers (group, row, array) only support 'hidden' logic type (same as pages). For other logic types (disabled, required, readonly, derivation), apply them to child fields instead. |
| `maxValue` | Use `maxValue` at field level for sliders, not `max` in props. |
| `minValue` | Use `minValue` at field level for sliders, not `min` in props. |
| `options` | Move `options` from `props: { options: [...] }` to field level: `{ key, type, options: [...] }` |
| `props` | Hidden fields do NOT support `props`. Remove it. |
| `reEngageOnDependencyChange` | `reEngageOnDependencyChange` requires `stopOnUserOverride: true`. Clears the user-override flag when dependencies change, allowing the derivation to run again. |
| `readonly` | Hidden fields do NOT support `readonly`. Remove it. |
| `required` | Hidden fields do NOT support `required`. Remove it. |
| `responseMapping` | Declarative HTTP validators require `responseMapping: { validWhen: "response.isValid", errorKind: "serverError" }`. `validWhen` is an expression evaluated with `{ response }` scope — truthy means valid. `errorKind` maps to `validationMessages`. |
| `showWhen` | Use `logic: [{ type: 'hidden', condition: {...} }]` with inverted condition - no `showWhen` shorthand exists. |
| `step` | Use `step` at field level for sliders, not in props. |
| `stopOnUserOverride` | `stopOnUserOverride` is a derivation option. When true, the derivation stops running after the user manually edits the field. Pair with `reEngageOnDependencyChange: true` to re-derive when dependencies change. |
| `targetField` | The `targetField` property has been removed. Define derivations directly on the target field using `derivation: '...'` or `logic: [{ type: 'derivation', expression: '...' }]`. |
| `template` | Arrays support two APIs: (1) Full API with `fields` for explicit item definitions, or (2) Simplified API with `template` + `value` for common cases. If using `template`, provide a single field for primitive arrays or an array of fields for object arrays. |
| `validWhen` | `validWhen` is a property of `responseMapping`, not a top-level validator property. Use: `responseMapping: { validWhen: "response.ok", errorKind: "..." }`. |
| `validators` | Hidden fields do NOT support validators. Remove the `validators` property. |
| `value` | Hidden fields REQUIRE a `value` property. Add: `value: "your-value-here"` |
